games.title: Cluck Horizon
games.reference: Original-IP second campaign on the Chicken Invaders engine

commands: CHROMIUM_PATH=<playwright chromium> npm run verify   # typecheck + npm test + hardest/validate.mjs + build + test:browser
npm run test:browser                                 # 46 playwright + 7 boxhead + 4 shmup + hardest + S&S browser gates
node delivery/site/lan-relay.mjs                     # LAN host+relay (verified with two real browser clients)
verification.results: All gates pass. npm test 46/46; hardest validator 114/114; Playwright suite 46/46 across chromium and firefox including two-browser LAN co-op and deathmatch; boxhead release pilots 7/7 (solo+coop die through the real damage path at wave 6+, deathmatch reaches 5 kills); shmup campaign pilots clear all 8 sectors on both packs over 5 seeds; S&S progression matrix 8,400 campaigns × 210 builds all complete; S&S browser full 16-bout campaign on desktop and emulated touch; subdirectory deployment verified under /magga/codex/. See records/VERIFICATION.md.
verification.evidence: records/ contains the per-game ship records and VERIFICATION.md; previews/ holds screenshots captured from the actual games.

limitations: Touch input verified via emulated pointer events, not physical devices; Safari untested (chromium and firefox verified).
Block Siege LAN play requires the bundled lan-relay.mjs host process (zero-dep Node 22+, one command, serves the site and pairs players); solo and local co-op/deathmatch run from static files alone.
The six bundled module apps require HTTP (ES modules); serve statically — they do not run from file://.
Original commercial assets are not reproduced; all titles, art, and names are original evocations.
